source_models.preservation_and_limit: Preserve native authentication identity, encoded password, account state and ownership.
Resolve roster/legal identity; preserve aliases/domains in archive and original source provenance.
Archive the original key and label; do not create a live legacy product row or force a product match. No live target is claimed until a later curated import establishes exact semantics.
Split family, edition and variant only after original-backed reconciliation; old effective dates/availability remain assertions.
Preserve original URL and declared role; verify official host and issuer.

Preserve every original observation payload, timestamp, status and source hash. Create an SourceCapture only when required per-attempt start/provenance can be established independently. fetched_at is not reliably an attempt start; otherwise retain an explicitly archived legacy observation without invented timing.
Verify exact bytes, digest, size and private ownership; original filesystem storage must be backed up separately.
Preserve edition assertions without treating a legacy published label as complete original review.
Reconcile roles, edition compatibility and applicability from originals; preserve old association as historical.
Retain extraction manifest/derivatives and versions as processing evidence; not independent originals.
Convert zero-based physical_index to explicit one-based page; preserve printed label, geometry and rotation exactly.
Retain quote, source offsets and exact old-to-new geometry map; verify original before reuse.
Preserve bundle identity/order; infer rule support only after independent review. No live target is claimed until a later curated import establishes exact semantics.
Retain all ordered span-role associations in archive; new roles require supported translation.
Old verification flag does not prove new independent rule coverage. Translate typed values/scope only when lossless.
Preserve exact statement and original support; curate explicit conditions/dependencies before publication.
Keep historical metric/value/date/source in archive. No new recommendation score from unsupported ratings. No live target is claimed until a later curated import establishes exact semantics.

Public premium observation is not an owner-bound quote; preserve as original observation until identity/inputs/validity established. No live target is claimed until a later curated import establishes exact semantics.
Preserve original review scope/reviewer/time; do not promote to new source or design approval. No live target is claimed until a later curated import establishes exact semantics.
Preserve source-stage attempts, counts and errors; legacy success is not corpus completeness.
Retain old manifest and selection as pilot channel; never auto-publish replacement corpus. No live target is claimed until a later curated import establishes exact semantics.
Preserve owner, UUID, title, timestamps and revision; interpret profile only after attributed fact reconciliation.
Archive the original profile JSON. Attribute only safely mapped values to customer statements; unattributed or model-proposed values remain unresolved and are never silently confirmed.
Preserve UUID, owner-through-conversation, role, exact content, origin and time; preserve answer linkage.
Preserve request identity and input/revision. Drain or explicitly cancel/recover active work before any cutover.
Preserve each attempt state/deadline/error; do not replay old inference or invent terminal results.
Preserve exact immutable route/model/settings lineage; keep secrets outside artifacts.
Preserve historical qualification result; each new actual schema/capability needs fresh qualification.
Preserve exact model identity, usage, timestamps, safe errors and request/response fingerprints.
Preserve answer blocks/text and validation scope at original revision; no new acceptance success. No live target is claimed until a later curated import establishes exact semantics.
Preserve claim text, support references and criticality; resolve original span identity explicitly. No live target is claimed until a later curated import establishes exact semantics.

Preserve all stored profile/rule/corpus/plan/calculation inputs; ambiguous conversation association remains unresolved. No live target is claimed until a later curated import establishes exact semantics.
Retain in the immutable migration archive for rollback evidence; do not select a live model route from the pilot preference.
